supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: extensions visible beyond the lateral canthi of the eyes

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: muzzle region exhibits significantly higher pixel intensity (lighter) compared to the darker periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thin 2D vertical profile with minimal structural droop

other_distinctive_markers: linear twig or tool-like object held in the mouth protruding toward the left of the frame
